title.text: Yield could fall this far before the corridor stops covering its cost (%)

The Gulf has the least room to absorb a yield decline of any corridor, because short sectors keep unit cost high
Headroom against IndiGo's achieved 5.06 INR per RPK, at the 81% load factor Indian carriers fly internationally. Unit cost is scaled from IndiGo's published 5.00 CASK at its 1,172 km system sector by a modelled elasticity of -0.25. This says nothing about where the volume is: the Gulf is still half the market and the recommendation rests on that, on bilateral position and on the connect premium, not on unit economics

annotations.text: Source: Unit costs and yields from IndiGo FY2026 and Emirates 2025-26 primary filings, verified in data/manual/assumptions.csv. Stage lengths are great circle from OurAirports (CC0); network averages and load factors computed from DGCA. Cost elasticity to stage length is modelled, see docs/methodology.md
